# Powertools for AWS Lambda (Go)

> Go Powertools Lambda: independent Go utilities for AWS Lambda, with structured logging, OpenTelemetry tracing, CloudWatch metrics and HTTP routing.

Project names: Go Powertools Lambda, Go Powertools, Powertools Lambda Go.

This is an independent community Go port of Powertools for AWS Lambda (TypeScript), not an official AWS distribution.
The English documentation follows main; Release notes identify published versions.
Start with the utility guides for code and results; use Compatibility for Go-specific behavior.
Target AWS Lambda provided.al2023 with CGO disabled on Linux amd64 or arm64.
Use OpenTelemetry and a collector's awsxray exporter for AWS X-Ray.
The legacy tracer/xray SDK adapter is deprecated and frozen.

The Optional section contains maintainer procedures, implementation plans and dated evidence.
Plans describe intended work; historical evidence establishes only its stated scope.
These pages do not override current usage guides or published release contracts.

- [Source repository](https://github.com/rambow-cloud/powertools-lambda-go)

## Home

- [Go Powertools Lambda](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/): Go Powertools Lambda adds structured logging, OpenTelemetry tracing, CloudWatch metrics and HTTP routing to Go AWS Lambda functions. Independent community project.

## Getting started

- [Getting started](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/getting-started/): Install Go Powertools modules, build your first AWS Lambda handler and understand supported runtimes, configuration and compatibility.
- [Your first Go Lambda](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/GETTING_STARTED/): Create a Go Lambda handler, see its JSON response and structured logs, then build a static executable for provided.al2023.
- [Install modules](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/MODULES/): Install Go Powertools modules for AWS Lambda. Choose utility import paths, understand independent dependencies and use the shared published release version.
- [Usage patterns](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/USAGE_PATTERNS/): Compose Powertools for Go utilities with correct object lifetimes, Lambda invocation scope, typed handlers and reusable clients.
- [Environment variables](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES/): Configure Powertools for Go logging, metrics and tracing using documented environment variables, defaults and option precedence.
- [Compatibility](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/COMPATIBILITY/)

## Observability

- [Observability](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/observability/): Add structured logging, OpenTelemetry tracing and CloudWatch metrics to Go AWS Lambda functions with independent Powertools modules.
- [Logger](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/LOGGER/): Write structured JSON logs in Go Lambda with context, correlation IDs, configurable levels and buffering using Powertools Logger.
- [Tracer](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/TRACER/): Trace Go Lambda handlers, HTTP requests and AWS SDK calls with OpenTelemetry. Deliver spans to AWS X-Ray through an OTLP collector.
- [Metrics](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/METRICS/): Emit CloudWatch Embedded Metric Format metrics from Go Lambda with Powertools Metrics, dimensions, validation and cold-start handling.

## Event handlers

- [Event handlers](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/event-handlers/): Build Go Lambda HTTP APIs with Get and Post routing, or resolve AppSync Events, AppSync GraphQL and Bedrock Agent function requests.
- [HTTP event handler](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/HTTP/): Route API Gateway and ALB events in Go Lambda using Powertools HTTP handlers, typed requests, responses and middleware.
- [HTTP CORS and compression](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/HTTP_MIDDLEWARE/): Configure CORS and response compression middleware for Powertools Go HTTP event handlers, including observable response behavior.
- [HTTP observability](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/HTTP_OBSERVABILITY/): Add structured logging, OpenTelemetry tracing and CloudWatch metrics to Go Lambda HTTP routes with Powertools middleware.
- [HTTP response streaming](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/HTTP_STREAMING/): Stream Go Lambda HTTP responses using Powertools, with streaming lifecycle, response contracts and complete examples.
- [AppSync Events](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/APPSYNC_EVENTS/): Handle AWS AppSync Events in Go Lambda with Powertools routing, publish and subscribe handlers and documented event contracts.
- [AppSync GraphQL](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/APPSYNC_GRAPHQL/): Resolve AWS AppSync GraphQL requests in Go Lambda with Powertools, including route dispatch, batching and error contracts.
- [Bedrock Agent function resolver](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/BEDROCK/): Resolve Amazon Bedrock Agent function requests in Go Lambda with Powertools, typed inputs, routing and response contracts.

## Data processing

- [Data processing](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/data-processing/): Process event batches, parse typed payloads, validate JSON, handle retries and decode Kafka data in Go AWS Lambda functions.
- [Batch processing](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/BATCH/): Process SQS, Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams batches in Go Lambda with Powertools partial failures, FIFO policies and typed handlers.
- [Idempotency](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/IDEMPOTENCY/): Protect Go Lambda operations from duplicate execution with Powertools Idempotency, DynamoDB persistence.
- [Redis and Valkey persistence](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/IDEMPOTENCY_CACHE/): Use Redis or Valkey persistence with Powertools Go Idempotency, including cache configuration, lease behavior and replay contracts.
- [Parser](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/PARSER/): Parse Go Lambda events into typed values and validate handler inputs using Powertools Parser and documented event models.
- [Stream and notification Parser contracts](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/PARSER_STREAMS/): Understand typed Go parsing contracts for stream and notification Lambda events, payload transformations and validation boundaries.
- [HTTP Parser contracts](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/PARSER_HTTP/): Parse API Gateway, ALB and other supported HTTP Lambda event shapes into typed Go models using Powertools Parser.
- [Parser AppSync and Cognito models](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/PARSER_IDENTITY/): Parse AppSync and Cognito Lambda events using Powertools Go models, including identity-event contracts and validation scope.
- [Parser service events and Kafka](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/PARSER_SERVICES/): Parse supported AWS service and Kafka Lambda events into typed Go values with documented Powertools Parser contracts.
- [Parser recursive errors and composition](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/PARSER_ERRORS/): Handle recursive validation errors and compose Powertools Go Parser operations with explicit paths, results and error contracts.
- [JSON Schema Validation](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/JSON_SCHEMA_VALIDATION/): Validate Go Lambda inputs and responses against JSON Schema with Powertools, compiled validators and structured diagnostics.
- [Validation keyword and numeric compatibility](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/VALIDATION_KEYWORDS/): Review Powertools Go JSON Schema keyword validation, numeric compatibility, supported behavior and diagnostic contracts.
- [Validation applicator diagnostics](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/VALIDATION_APPLICATORS/): Understand Go JSON Schema applicators and error diagnostics for composed schemas using Powertools Validation.
- [Validation type groups and references](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/VALIDATION_REFERENCES/): Use JSON Schema type groups and references with Powertools Go Validation, including resource and diagnostic boundaries.
- [Validation condition graphs and external resource registration](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/VALIDATION_GRAPHS/): Work with JSON Schema condition graphs and external schema resources using Powertools Go Validation.
- [Validation schema-shape and conditional compilation compatibility](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/VALIDATION_SHAPES/): Review JSON Schema shapes and conditional compilation contracts in Powertools Go Validation.
- [Validation strict-schema compatibility](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/VALIDATION_STRICT/): Configure strict schema validation in Powertools for Go and understand compilation checks, compatibility and diagnostics.
- [Validation regular expressions](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/VALIDATION_REGEX/): Use ECMAScript regular expression matching in Powertools Go JSON Schema Validation with documented Unicode and compatibility boundaries.
- [JMESPath](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/JMESPATH/): Query JSON and extract Lambda event envelopes with Powertools Go JMESPath, compiled expressions.
- [Kafka consumer](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/KAFKA/): Decode Kafka Lambda events in Go with Powertools JSON handling, headers and optional Avro or Protobuf adapters.
- [Kafka Avro and Protobuf](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/KAFKA_BINARY/): Decode Kafka Avro and Protobuf payloads with optional Powertools Go adapters and documented binary format contracts.
- [Kafka delivery modes](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/KAFKA_MODES/): Understand Kafka Lambda source and JSON event modes, payload decoding and Go Powertools compatibility boundaries.

## Security and configuration

- [Security and configuration](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/security/): Retrieve cached application parameters, mask sensitive fields and sign AWS HTTP requests with Go Powertools Lambda utilities.
- [Parameters](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/PARAMETERS/): Retrieve and cache Go Lambda configuration from SSM, Secrets Manager, DynamoDB and AppConfig using Powertools Parameters.
- [Data Masking](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/DATAMASKING/): Erase or transform selected Go Lambda payload fields with Powertools Data Masking, ordered rules and optional regex or KMS providers.
- [Encrypt selected fields with KMS](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/DATAMASKING_KMS/): Encrypt and decrypt masked Go payload fields with the optional Powertools KMS provider and documented AWS Encryption SDK interoperability.
- [Signer](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/SIGNER/): Sign Go HTTP requests using AWS Signature Version 4 with Powertools Signer, credentials and reusable signing transports.

## Release notes

- [Release notes](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/RELEASE_NOTES/): Read published Powertools for Go release notes, stable and prerelease versions, component changes and canonical GitHub Release links.

## Commons and Metadata

- [Commons](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/COMMONS/): Reuse dependency-free Powertools Go runtime primitives and one shared Lambda invocation identity across independent utilities.
- [Metadata](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/METADATA/): Retrieve Lambda execution-environment metadata in Go with the optional Powertools Metadata client.
- [ECMAScript regular expressions](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/REGEX/): Use shared ECMAScript regular expression matching and replacement in Powertools for Go with documented Unicode behavior.
- [Commons reuse audit](https://powertools-lambda-go.rambow.cloud/COMMONS_REUSE/): Review shared primitive ownership and reuse across Powertools Go modules, including invocation identity and dependency boundaries.
